description: This file defines the HoverInterceptorView class, a custom Android view extending LinearLayout that intercepts hover events based on a toggled flag, primarily used within a demo activity to illustrate hover event interception.

classes.name: HoverInterceptorView
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that can intercept hover events based on a boolean flag. It updates a TextView message when hover events are intercepted or pass through.

methods.name: HoverInterceptorView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view with context and attribute set.

methods.name: onInterceptHoverEvent
methods.description: Overrides default to intercept hover events if mInterceptHover is true.

methods.name: onHoverEvent
methods.description: Overrides default to update UI messages based on hover state and whether interception is enabled.

methods.name: setInterceptHover
methods.description: Sets the flag to determine if hover events should be intercepted.
